fig.title: RTIM Impact Example: 15W TDP Package, ACT

body.p: Improving RTIM will result in significant improvements on short duration (3-5s) turbo power (PL2) despite marginal to negligible improvements to S.S.

Nomenclature:
Power Capability: Additional power the processor can support before reaching Tj-max
TIM: Thermal Interface Material
RTIM: TIM Thermal Impedance
S.S. : Steady State
ACT: All-Core-Turbo
body.note: For Liquid Metal Implementation, refer to the Technical Training Course #1002057.
